label: Bible Study
prompt: For other _____ can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
verse: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
note: Paul the master builder says there's only one foundation worth laying.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Therefore I will _____ unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
verse: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
note: When friends and family let him down, Micah says: I will look unto the LORD — my God will hear me.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with _____?
verse: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
note: God's nature tour for Job includes the warhorse — its neck 'clothed with thunder,' where modern versions say mane.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross _____, and follow me.
verse: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
note: Only Luke's version adds 'daily' — cross-bearing isn't a one-time event but a morning routine.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your _____.
verse: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.
note: Israel grumbled for bread, and God heard every one of their 'murmurings' — then answered with manna anyway.
